# CALPQ Contract — Name

Status: `PROPOSED`

ID: `CALPQ-CONTRACT-NNNN`

## Purpose

Describe the boundary or capability this contract defines.

## Owner

Identify the owning layer or domain.

## Consumers

List the layers, modules or external adapters allowed to depend on this contract.

## Inputs

Define accepted inputs, required fields and validation expectations.

## Outputs

Define outputs, states and observable results.

## Invariants

List conditions that must always remain true.

## Errors and failure behavior

Define expected failure categories and safe behavior. Do not expose implementation details as domain semantics.

## Evidence and provenance

Describe which source, actor, time or version information must remain traceable.

## Compatibility

State versioning, migration and backward-compatibility expectations.

## Verification

List invariant, contract, integration and negative tests required for the boundary.

## Change control

Material changes require impact analysis and an ADR when they affect architecture, persistence, external compatibility or regulated behavior.
